installer-gui-script.title: HeadscaleClient

choice.title: HeadscaleClient
choice.description: 安装客户端及备用组件；只在需要时注册自带网络服务。 Install the client and inactive bundled components; register a network service only when needed.

choice.title: 复用现有 Tailscale 服务 / Reuse existing service
choice.description: 检测到外部服务。不覆盖、不卸载，不启动第二套服务；原服务必须可访问。 External service detected. It will be left unchanged; it must be accessible to the client.

choice.title: 更新本产品服务，保留账号 / Update managed service
choice.description: 只更新 HeadscaleClient 管理的服务，保留身份与配置。 Only the product-owned service is updated; identities and settings are preserved.

choice.title: 自动检测网络服务 / Automatic service detection
choice.description: 安装时再次检查：有外部服务则复用，没有才安装自带服务。 Installation rechecks running services: reuse an existing service, otherwise install the bundled service.

choice.title: 检测到两套服务，请先处理冲突 / Resolve service conflict
choice.description: 安装器不会自动移除其中一套服务。请先移除不需要的服务再安装。 No service will be removed automatically. Remove the unwanted installation before retrying.
